say:2:1711164003:1.text: Therefore, due to the limitations of the underlying rules of reversal magic, the ultimate price Mordrine paid was—
say:2:1711164003:1.source_cn: 所以，基于逆转魔法底层规则的限制，莫德琳承担的最终代价是——

say:5:1711164005:1.text: No need to waste your energy on me anymore. I'm already prepared to accept all of this.
say:5:1711164005:1.source_cn: 不用……再为我白费力气了。我早就准备好了……接受这一切。
